text: 4.9 1 I couldn't agree more. 2 How did this whole gift-giving for every holiday tradition get started anyway? It seems silly to me. 3 I agree. I get tired of shopping for gifts. 4 I disagree. I like giving gifts. 5 But I'm not convinced because then you have to spend money. Money which could be spent on more important things. 6 Instead, why not write letters of advice for the future? That would be more special. 7 Sorry, I don't agree. I doubt that graduates will be happy if we change that custom.
